purpose: Adversarial literature screen for a distinct Binance USDT-M, at-most-two-position candidate after the capital-preservation policy removed all monthly-return targets. This document is a screening record only: it does not access candidate returns, create an experiment, or change any sealed protocol.
admission_constraints: at most two simultaneous positions and one-times planned leverage
causal, timestamped decision data with reproducible historical provenance
actual or preregistered conservative fee, slippage, and funding accounting
a mechanism independent of sealed failed or accumulating families
no parameter search or condition added merely to revive a failed candidate

candidates.name: FUNDING_DRAG_VOLATILITY_CONDITIONAL_REVERSAL
candidates.source_claim: The paper reports that the correction speed after extreme negative funding varies materially with realized volatility across Binance perpetual events.
candidates.reason: The observable is an extreme funding event followed by reversal, which is the same economic family as sealed ALPHA_005_FUNDING_EXTREME_REVERSAL. Adding realized-volatility conditioning after Alpha #5 failed would be a prohibited post-hoc rescue, not independent evidence.
candidates.retain: Keep only as an explanation of why Alpha #5 cannot be generalized from an unconditioned result. Do not register a volatility-filtered Alpha #5 successor on the same family.

candidates.name: PREVIOUS_DAY_VOLUME_PROFILE_TAPE_SPEED_MEAN_REVERSION
candidates.source_claim: A single-contract SOL/USDT perpetual backtest reports previous-day volume-profile context, tape-speed confirmation, and transaction-cost sensitivity.
candidates.reason: The accessible source is an independent working paper without a sealed public raw-data inventory, executable causal tape-speed definition, or a fully specified point-in-time execution protocol. Its reversion component overlaps sealed Alpha #2 and its tape-speed component overlaps the order-flow research family. Opening a trial would therefore mix an insufficiently reproducible method with two already evaluated families.
candidates.retain: Reconsider only if a complete immutable data and code release makes the signal definition independently executable and a new mechanism can be demonstrated before any return inspection.

candidates.name: PERPETUAL_BASIS_VOLATILITY_FORECAST
candidates.source_claim: The study reports that absolute perpetual-spot basis forecasts realized volatility for several non-BTC Binance perpetuals, with weaker evidence after stronger volatility benchmarks.
candidates.reason: The reported object is volatility, not a signed return edge. It may inform a future independently preregistered risk overlay, but it cannot by itself satisfy the positive cost-after alpha requirement and must not be relabeled as one.
candidates.retain: Use only as a literature reference when evaluating non-directional entry-suppression overlays after the current forward telemetry study completes.

candidates.name: COST_AWARE_HOURLY_MACHINE_LEARNING_DIRECTIONAL_FILTER
candidates.source_claim: The study finds that cost-aware execution filters can materially alter selected hourly BTC model outcomes after a multi-fold walk-forward model comparison.
candidates.reason: Its reported result is conditional on a broad model and configuration search. Reproducing it would require a predeclared trial inventory, training labels, feature availability audit, and a selection-bias protocol beyond the present data release. Beginning from the reported winning setup would be outcome-following rather than an independent hypothesis.
candidates.retain: Keep as validation-infrastructure evidence only. Do not start a machine-learning candidate without a separately sealed full trial inventory before historical return access.

candidates.name: POINT_IN_TIME_PERPETUAL_ARCHIVE_AUDIT
candidates.source_claim: The audit distinguishes event, publication, and availability times in public Binance BTC perpetual archives and reports negative matched-budget tests under causal constraints.
candidates.reason: It supplies data-governance discipline and cautions against treating unverifiable open-interest publication times as decision features. It supplies no independent directional signal for a new candidate.
candidates.retain: Apply its point-in-time discipline to every future candidate; do not count it as alpha evidence.

next_action: Continue the running forward-only liquidation-risk telemetry collection without altering its preregistered trigger or validation boundary. A new alpha may be opened only after a distinct, reproducible mechanism passes this admission screen before return analysis.
